How Long Will Cigna Cover Drug Rehab?

The length of time that Cigna will provide coverage for drug rehab will vary from person to person. A piece of this is that Cigna offers customized healthcare plans that have differences in their policy plans. These differences can impact your coverage options. Personal characteristics such as what substance you are using, the severity of your addiction, the presence of other mental health concerns, and lifestyle risk factors are also considered when determining the length of your coverage.

How to Verify Cigna Insurance Drug Rehab Coverage

If you are a Cigna member and are wondering what drug rehab coverage you are eligible for, you can choose between calling a Cigna representative or using their website. By calling the telephone number on the back of your ID card, a Cigna representative can provide you with a list of local addiction treatment providers who are in-network. Additionally, they can provide you with insight into what your financial responsibility would be for various levels of care. Your second option would be to access their member portal by logging into your personal account. From here, you can find information regarding your plan. Additionally, you will be able to search for addiction treatment providers who are in-network.
